title: Preserve identity proofs across bounded independent part reviews
body:
Jinshu 093’s identity parts were forced into one growing review conversation, and recording recomputed their layout from the current byte-limit constant. Fresh preparation now pins a 256 KiB transport policy, while recording reproduces the exact saved policy and byte-identical layout. Separate independent conversations can own different parts; the complete chapter, person/anchor evidence, exact case coverage and every actual producer remain required.

The recorder rejects missing policy, invented aggregate contributor/run pairs, changed part bytes and extraction authors in any part. Already certified proofs retain normal source revalidation, and explicitly pinned earlier captures remain reproducible. No chapter can publish from a partial review.

Validation: 61 identity checks and both native recording/website fixtures passed, including exact default-byte boundaries, oversized-case holds, a nine-part prepare/record round trip, retained two-part captures and full source revalidation with different independent producers. Independent recheck of this revision and required CI remain pending. One-hour live throughput is not yet proven.
